entries.name: AccountPolicy
entries.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/account_policy.rs (Policy, PolicyTable); springboard/src/bare/account_policy.rs; springboard/src/privd/accounts.rs (set_policy); springboard/src/shell/users_page.rs (CONTENT LIMITS); springboard/src/shell/services/privacy_permissions.rs (access, location_status); springboard/src/shell/store/sheet.rs (purchase refusal)
entries.note: A policy table per account (springboard/ui/src/account_policy.rs) with a text form. Built 2026-10-17: the launcher refuses a blocked app for the installed account (springboard/src/bare/account_policy.rs, reads /var/lib/springboard/account-policy; a damaged file refuses every launch); Settings > Users & Groups > CONTENT LIMITS writes a managed account's rules through privd's account.set_policy (validated and written atomically); the privacy gates answer camera, microphone and location as restricted, and the store purchase sheet refuses Buy, while the installed account's limits switch them off. Still missing: the account service as its own owner of the policy (privd is the only writer now), and limits for sessions of other accounts, since the shell runs only the installed account.
entries.ready_note: Launch refusal (bare::account_policy), the policy file format (account_policy::tests), the content limits page (users_page tests), and the privacy and purchase gates read the same table. A damaged table refuses or switches off; the installed account has no limits.
